title: Degree of an embedded univariate polynomial
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a type, let $i\in\sigma$, and let $p$ be a polynomial over $\mathbb R$. Regard $p$ as a multivariate polynomial in the single variable indexed by $i$. Its total degree equals the natural degree of $p$.
